children: Lean hog futures are falling as packer demand remains low. "Hogs are being pressured by sharp weakness in the cash market as market-ready supplies are abundant," says Brian Grete of Commstock Investments. "Packers have more than enough hogs, and are in some cases, slowing slaughter runs as they can't move the pork fast enough." Hogs are down 3.4% on CME at 62.45 cents a pound. Live cattle slip 0.3% to $2.3045 a pound. (anthony.harrup@wsj.com)
